examples.text: Der Efeu bringt ein pfeilförmiges Blatt von dunkelgrüner Farbe hervor.

glosses: Shaped like an arrowhead, with one point at one end, and two points at the other.
Shaped like an arrowhead, with two pointed lobes extending downward from the base.
Having the form of an arrowhead, but lacking flaring lobes on the base.

examples.text: This tree has sagittiform leaves, which lack divisions and subdivisions.
Now the Storm begins to lovver, / (Haſte, the loom of Hell prepare,) / Iron-ſleet of arrovvy ſhovver / Hurtles in the darken'd air.

glosses: Formed or moving like, or in any respect resembling, an arrow; for example, slender, straight, or swift.

examples.text: I saw him in his boat, which shot across the waters with an arrowy swiftness, and was soon lost amidst the waves.
Een pijlvormig blad heeft aan de voet twee achterwaarts gerichte, spitse lobben.
